# loci

> A local second brain that indexes notes and docs for hybrid search and question answering with citations, exposed as an MCP server, terminal tool, and web console.

Requires Python 3.11+; install as loci-rag via pip, run `loci demo` with no configuration to try keyword-only search, and configure providers in config.toml for hybrid search. Key components: loci-mcp MCP server, web console at 127.0.0.1:8765/ui, and an optional native Rust build using a single SQLite index. All MCP clients should point at the same LOCI_HOME instance directory to share config, index, and memory files.

## Docs

- [loci README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/README.md): Turning notes and agent memories into a searchable knowledge base with citations, as MCP server, terminal, or browser.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Data flow into ChromaDB, module overview, identity and chunk ID invariants, and recipes for extending loaders, retrieval, and MCP tools.
- [Usage guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/docs/guide.en.md): Model provider configuration, hybrid retrieval demo with bilingual queries, reranking setup, and indexing PDFs, Word, org files and chat logs.
- [Connect an Obsidian vault to loci (Python build)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/docs/obsidian.en.md): Setting up loci against an Obsidian vault on the Python build: selective scanning, config editing, and API key handling.
- [Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/docs/roadmap.md): Shipped features by release, including the HTML and org-mode loaders, MCP server, hybrid retrieval, and planned work.
